platform_roles.x: the only platform this account publishes to: one English post (2-3 only when a runnable example needs them) plus one actual 16:9 image

mission: Turn one real AI-workflow artifact into one defensible English X post, or publish nothing.
promise: An English account for indie AI builders and freelancers: what actually changed in a real workflow, what it cost, and where it failed, with the artifact to check it against.
tagline: A workflow claim is worth what its artifact is worth.
decision_question: Should I keep doing this workflow this way, or change exactly one step?
audience: English-speaking indie AI builders and freelancers shipping useful automations with agent tooling.
core_audience: A solo builder who runs agent workflows on real client or product work and has to decide, this week, whether to change one step of them.

audience_layers.who: Indie AI builder or freelancer running agent tooling on real deliverables
audience_layers.job: Decide whether a workflow step should change, and what would prove it
audience_layers.reads_for: the artifact, the failure mode, the reproduction command

audience_layers.who: A technically literate founder evaluating tools and vendors
audience_layers.job: Separate a vendor claim from a demonstrated result
audience_layers.reads_for: the boundary between what the source says and what was actually run

content_pillars.name: workflow_artifact
content_pillars.scope: Two of every three posts: a real workflow, its pain, an artifact, benchmark or failed step, and the reproduction or the decision it supports.

content_pillars.name: source_analysis
content_pillars.scope: One of every three: independent analysis of a relevant tool update, anchored to the same buyer and job. A mechanism and a counterexample are mandatory.

content_pillars_note.reason: vendor/x-growth-os/docs/X-GROWTH-RECOVERY-2026-10-26.md §1 and §6 record 30/30/20/20 as a content-mix hypothesis, not a proven schedule, and suspend the daily quota during recovery. The old mix is kept here so it is neither silently forgotten nor accidentally restored.

non_negotiable: No invented numbers, results, clients or performance claims; a prediction is labelled as one.
A post with no permission-cleared firsthand artifact carries SOURCE_ANALYSIS and may not say 'I tested', 'we ran' or claim a measured result.
Every post carries an actual 1600x900 PNG or JPEG; an SVG alone is not an X-uploadable image.
Human review is recorded by a person; an assistant may prepare it and never approve it.
published requires a real https://x.com/<handle>/status/<digits> URL; nothing else counts.
Unobserved metrics stay null; an empty cell is not a zero.
No automated likes, follow/unfollow, reply bots, scheduled browser actions or duplicative posting.

evidence.note: claim_coverage.EVIDENCE_MODES (CLAIM_LED / EVIDENCE_LED / EXPLANATORY) is the video vocabulary and describes how a film is composed. An X post's evidence question is a proof grade, so this account declares proof_ladder beside it. Routing resolves the DNA's 'pipeline' first and never reads a video mode off this file.

proof_ladder.P0: Primary source read only: the post cites what the source says, never what the author achieved.
proof_ladder.P1: Locally run example with the exact version, a minimal sanitized input/output, the command and the failure modes.
proof_ladder.P2: Same-task baseline versus the changed workflow, including human review time, errors, cost and repeatability.
proof_ladder.P3: Qualified external feedback or a permission-cleared buyer pilot with traceable outcomes. Not automatic paid demand.

rules: A practical-results claim needs at least one permission-cleared firsthand artifact: code, a reproducible command, a consented before/after comparison, a permitted screenshot or a trace with identifiers removed.
A source URL is not mandatory inside the 280 characters; the claim stays traceable in the post record.
There is no proven universal external-link penalty; do not use a hidden-link trick.

evidence_ladder.rule: A lower rung never proves a higher one. An impression is not a reader, a like is not a qualified reply, and a profile visit is not a follow.
evidence_ladder.note: Only observed native metrics move a rung, at a recorded age window (T+2H / T+24H / T+72H / T+7D). The rates are a funnel of observations, never one algorithm score and never an attribution model.

editorial.char_metric: X weighted length: a URL counts 23, CJK/fullwidth/emoji count 2, everything else counts 1. The raw string length is not the final length.

review_dimensions.high: firsthand, with scope and counterexample stated
which step changed, why, and when it stops working
changes one real tool, build or purchasing decision
names an input, an output and a metric that could refute it
the first two sentences state a real technical contradiction and its consequence

editorial.prompts_note: These five are the vendored workflow's own prompts, referenced by path. A record may name one in 'prompt_ref' so a reader can see which brief it was written from; the gate only checks that the name is declared here and the file is really in this tree. Nothing here generates copy, and the tutorial prompt is a reference only -- the tutorial track is not wired into this account.
editorial.score_note: 24/30 with novelty, evidence and mechanism each >=4 is a human editorial heuristic, not an X ranking formula and not evidence of reach. A self-awarded perfect score authorizes nothing on its own; the recovery fields and the proof grade are what the gate reads.

visual.rule: The image must carry this post's exact claim, not a generic tech motif. Deterministic HTML -> PNG for anything with text or numbers, so labels stay legible at ~400px width. A conceptual illustration is allowed and must not pose as a benchmark, a real screenshot or a measured effect. If the image is absent, mismatched or unreadable, the post stays draft and is not recommended for publishing.

publication.rule: The workflow emits a publish package a person posts by hand. No X API call and no credentials in this repository. The handle is genuinely unknown until the first real status URL teaches it; recording it from that URL is allowed, guessing it is not.

cadence.rule: Three or four original posts a week from at most one real source artifact, and ten to fifteen minutes a day of manual reading and replying. No quota-driven triple-post day.
cadence.note: A workload and confounder control from the 14-day recovery experiment, not an asserted X algorithm optimum.

business.hypothesis: A narrow, artifact-backed workflow account earns qualified replies from indie AI builders before it earns reach.
business.rule: Content may feed the business; it may not move the business stage. Follower count and a self-awarded score are not demand.
not_claimed: that a post caused any follower change
paid demand from any external feedback

metrics.how: share of packages a person actually published, counted from real status URLs
unique relevant questions or requests / impressions, manually coded, both observed
record founder minutes and rework count per post
end minus start followers on account snapshots, never attributed to one post
every claim binds to its proof grade and its artifact ref
share of posts whose image is approved on the first render
the single experiment variable recorded per post and read back at T+7D

forbidden: generated evidence substituted for real screenshots
deleting or reposting a low-performing post as a growth tactic
engagement bait, quote-tweet dunks and unsolicited automated replies
a conceptual illustration presented as measured performance

brand.slogan: A workflow claim is worth what its artifact is worth.
brand.palette_note: The same brand as the video accounts: one accent colour, and a literal failure marker that may only appear while the failure exists.
forbidden_effects: stock robot or neon cyber imagery

skill_route.why: owns the rights-aware candidate record (page, creator, licence, URL) that a post's unique_artifact_ref must descend from
owns the three competing theses and the red-team pass above the deterministic character check
owns the 16:9 horizontal quote/data card and its card-design system; the deterministic HTML -> PNG render is what makes text and numbers exact
